notes:
おさめる has different kanji depending on the meaning. This entry covers the {収|おさ}める writing.

KANJI VARIATIONS:
- {収|おさ}める: to store, obtain, achieve
- ⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay, deliver, dedicate
- ⟦{治|おさ}める→治める：02462_osameru⟧: to govern, rule
- ⟦{修|おさ}める→修める：27839_osameru⟧: to study, master

COMMON EXPRESSIONS ({収|おさ}める):
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収|おさ}める: to achieve success
- ⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収|おさ}める: to win victory
- ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収|おさ}める: to produce results
- ⟦{鞘|さや}→鞘：14698_saya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{収|おさ}める: to sheathe (a sword)
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{収|おさ}める: to capture in a photo

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収|おさ}める

The kanji {収|しゅう} relates to gathering and collecting, which connects all three senses: storing (gathering in), achieving (gathering results), paying (gathering funds to deliver).

ASPECT (ている):
- {収|おさ}めている: has achieved / currently holds (resultative state)
- Note: In the "achieve" sense, {収|おさ}めている expresses a lasting accomplishment, not an ongoing process. ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{収|おさ}めている means "has achieved great success" (and that success continues), not "is in the process of succeeding."
